person.name: John H Davis (Son of Maurice)
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-27 from profile 8890.] John H Davis, b. abt 1889, son of Morris Davis (12006) and Hester A. Morris Davis (11247). Split off profile 8890 under Jequan Davis's conflation ruling of 2026-11-22 (three-way split). The 1900 census (Indian River Hundred) enumerates him as Son, age 11, in the household of Maurice Davis (Head, age 43) and Hester A Davis (Wife, age 22), with siblings Bertha M, Stephen F, and Charley M, who are profiled as children of Morris Davis and Hester A. Morris Davis; the census head's name 'Maurice' is the same man as Morris Davis (12006), Hester's husband. The two census-document photos formerly on 8890 (the 1900 household and a WWI-era household) belong to this man and moved with him. Flagged unproven beyond the census fact.
